clue.text: Made social contact in a crowded underground train perhaps?

definitions.text: Made social contact in a crowded underground train perhaps?

parts.words: Made social contact in a crowded underground train perhaps
parts.note: the idiom for mixing with other people is pictured literally as passengers pressed against each other in a packed carriage

explanation.surface: A commuter makes acquaintances while squashed into a rush-hour tube carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means mixing socially with people, often of a higher rank; in a packed train it happens physically.

clue.text: Fundamentally like a bad apple

parts.note: a fruit decayed right through to its centre stands for a person thoroughly corrupt by nature

explanation.surface: A remark on a thoroughly spoilt piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes someone corrupt through and through, as a fruit decayed right to its centre.

clue.text: Kind of jazz music to become second-class work

parts.note: to become is to be
B is the grade below A, second class
OP, short for opus, is a musical work

explanation.surface: Some jazz style is dismissed as inferior work.
explanation.definitionFit: Bebop is a fast, complex style of jazz developed in the 1940s.

clue.text: Mere lad crushing a gem-stone

indicators.note: crushing the letters of the two words breaks them up so they can be reformed

explanation.surface: A lad called Mere smashes a precious stone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crushing' reads as the boy doing the crushing, but it signals rearranging MERELAD.
explanation.definitionFit: An emerald is a green precious stone, a variety of beryl.

clue.text: In a strict way cunning bird was included

indicators.note: the bird word was included inside the word for cunning, a container signal

parts.note: cunning means sly
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A crafty bird was firmly admitted into a group.
explanation.definitionFit: Sternly means severely or with strictness.

clue.text: Unceremoniously without preparation

definitions.meaning: brusquely, in a casually curt manner
done on the spur of the moment, impromptu

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a curt casual manner and something done impromptu, unrehearsed.

clue.text: Straw hat is foul, so to speak

definitions.meaning: a hat of plaited straw from Livorno in Italy bears this name
said aloud, foul sounds like fowl, and this is a breed of domestic chicken

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition works by sound: 'foul' is heard as 'fowl', a chicken, of which this is a breed.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of the Italian port Livorno in English gives both a plaited straw hat and a chicken breed.

clue.text: Inspired with love despite the awful demeanour

indicators.note: an awful version of the word is a badly mangled one, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone falls in love regardless of the other person's dreadful manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Enamoured means filled with love for someone, smitten.

clue.text: Might he be a wandering minstrel?

definitions.text: Might he be a wandering minstrel?

parts.words: Might he be a wandering minstrel
parts.note: a travelling musician is described as an itinerant performer who walks from town to town

explanation.surface: A question about whether a man is a travelling singer.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically, an itinerant actor or musician who travelled the country performing.

clue.text: Extension for dining

parts.note: an extra board slotted in to lengthen a dining surface

explanation.surface: A building extension intended as a dining room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extension' suggests building work, but it is a removable board that lengthens a table.
explanation.definitionFit: A removable or hinged board that extends a dining table.

clue.text: A girl scrambled only part of an egg

indicators.note: scrambled letters are mixed up, fitting the egg theme

explanation.surface: A girl scrambles eggs, using only some of each.
explanation.definitionFit: Glair is egg white, especially used as a glaze or size.

clue.text: Make clear that it was flat

parts.note: EX means former, what something once was
plain means flat land, a level expanse

explanation.surface: Someone asks for clarification of the claim that it was flat.
explanation.definitionFit: To explain is to make something understandable.

clue.text: Short axe and another tool left by an amphibian

indicators.note: short means the word is cut, losing its final letter
another tool here means the word tool made into another arrangement

explanation.surface: A small axe and a second implement are abandoned by a salamander.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' trims axe to AX; 'another' rearranges TOOL to OLOT.
explanation.definitionFit: The axolotl is a Mexican salamander that keeps its larval form.

clue.text: The man that's left when he leaves Helen

indicators.note: when one word leaves another its letters are removed from it

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A man remains after a partner walks out on Helen.
explanation.definitionFit: Len is a man's name, short for Leonard.

clue.text: Man acts lazily but faint heartedly

parts.note: Tim is a man's name
lazily means idly

explanation.surface: A man moves sluggishly but without courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'acts' is a link word joining the man to his manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Timidly means shyly, without courage.

clue.text: Treat roughly the fellow with a title

parts.note: a fellow is a man
a handle is slang for a title or name

explanation.surface: A man with an aristocratic title is described.
explanation.definitionFit: To manhandle is to push or shove someone about roughly.

clue.text: Short man misses half the school period

indicators.note: missing half of the word means its second three letters are dropped

parts.note: a lesson is a period of school teaching

explanation.surface: A small man misses half the class.
explanation.definitionFit: Les is a shortened man's name, from Leslie.

clue.text: Ancient coins confused, i.e. with dinar

indicators.note: confused letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone muddles old Roman money with a dinar.
explanation.definitionFit: Denarii were silver coins of ancient Rome.

clue.text: Partly relieved to see an old priest

indicators.note: partly means only part of the word is used, the run inside it

explanation.surface: Someone is somewhat relieved to see an elderly clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: Eli was the priest of Shiloh in the Old Testament who raised Samuel.

clue.text: Smallest one in the home after it was returned

indicators.note: the home part comes after the turned word
returned means turned back, so the word it is read backwards
the one is put in the home, a container signal

parts.note: a nest is a home
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: The tiniest person stays home once something was given back.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiniest is the superlative of tiny, meaning smallest.

clue.text: Gone out with Tex performing in court

indicators.note: performing letters go through their paces, changing order

explanation.surface: A man called Tex appears in a courtroom and has left.
explanation.definitionFit: Extinct describes a fire or volcano no longer burning, gone out.

clue.text: Ends school period in one

parts.note: a term is a period of the school year
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A school term finishes all at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Termini are end points, especially of railway lines.

clue.text: One of a pair of metal stands having rough ride in the mist

definitions.text: One of a pair of metal stands

indicators.note: the jumbled ride goes in the mist, a container signal

parts.note: fog is mist

indicators.note: a rough version of the word is a disordered one

explanation.surface: Riding over bumpy ground through mist, someone carries a metal stand.
explanation.definitionFit: A firedog is an andiron, one of a pair of metal supports for logs in a fireplace.

clue.text: When many are in the grip of an extremist

indicators.note: the pieces go in the grip, a container signal

parts.note: a fist is a clenched grip
as means when
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many

explanation.surface: Many people are caught in the grasp of an extremist.
explanation.definitionFit: A fascist is an adherent of authoritarian far-right politics.

clue.text: Nice environment

parts.note: the French city of Nice sits in this coastal region, read as pleasant surroundings

explanation.surface: Pleasant surroundings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nice' at the start hides its capital: it is the French city, not pleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: The French coastal region on the Mediterranean includes the city of Nice.

clue.text: Time in general

indicators.note: in signals the run of letters sitting inside the word

explanation.surface: Time described in general terms.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is a period of time.

clue.text: One to enforce payment from former player

parts.note: EX means former
a player is an actor

explanation.surface: Money is demanded from a retired performer.
explanation.definitionFit: An exactor is one who demands or extorts payment.

clue.text: Quite a few to part with a pound

parts.note: to part is to sever
L is the abbreviation for pound, from libra

explanation.surface: Many must part with a pound.
explanation.definitionFit: Several means more than two but not many, a handful.

clue.text: Cook a sort of stew

indicators.note: to stew is to churn up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cook prepares a kind of stew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stew' looks like a dish, but it is the anagram signal for A SORT.
explanation.definitionFit: To roast is to cook in an oven or over a fire.

clue.text: Ancient penny formerly held by Lone Ranger

indicators.note: the penny is held inside the other letters, a container signal
to range is to roam about, so the letters wander into a new order

parts.note: D was the abbreviation for a penny in pre-decimal British money

explanation.surface: An old coin was once carried by the Lone Ranger, the cowboy hero.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lone Ranger is a famous cowboy, but 'Ranger' is the anagram signal for LONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Olden means of former times, old.

clue.text: Train ie. jerky taking railway route

indicators.note: a jerky train jolts its letters about into a new order

explanation.surface: A jerky train takes a railway journey.
explanation.definitionFit: An itinerary is a planned route or journey.

clue.text: It pops up at breakfast time

definitions.text: It pops up at breakfast time

parts.words: It pops up at breakfast time
parts.note: a kitchen appliance springs bread up when done in the morning

explanation.surface: Something appears regularly at breakfast.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen appliance that browns bread and ejects the slices when ready.
